items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: And he wanted to form a record company. Yeah. And he got in touch with us. And we recorded, Tell It Like It Is.

ctx.x: How were you involved with Par Love?

Uh, I was contacted by a guy, a guy by the name of, uh, uh, uh, what's his name again now? I don't know it. I know it was George Davis. Right. I know George Davis. And, uh, Warren Parker, who was, uh, uh, art teacher out at Xavier University. Okay. And he wanted to form a record company. Yeah. And he got in touch with us. And we recorded, Tell It Like It Is.
Uh, so it was, who, who was involved? It was, uh, Rob? Uh, Warren Parker.
